messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — inference-runtime pool 'mr-prod-3' reporting elevated 5xx (502/504) and timeouts. Error rate 14% over last 5m, CPU/GPU errors correlated. Paging @alice_oncall

alice_oncall: on it. taking pager. moving discussion here. any immediate customer impact? :eyes:

bob_sre: pulling up dashboards. seeing a spike in 502s from model-runner instances on mr-prod-3, concurrent increase in kernel OOM logs and a few segfaults.

eve_support: support queue: 6 tickets from WidgetCo, 2 from BetaOrg, messages show request failed with 502 and sometimes 30s timeouts. Customers calling.

carla_runtime: grabbing logs from a crashed runner:
```
[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] model-runner[pid=8421]: kvcache_alloc failed: OOM (alloc 2147483648)
[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] model-runner[pid=8421]: fatal signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at ip 0x7f3a1c2b4f0
#0  0x7f3a1c2b4f0 in quant_attention_kernel+0x1b0 (quant_attention.c:412)
#1  0x7f3a1c3d2a0 in runtimes::dispatch_single_batch()
```
Looks like OOM on KV cache followed by segfault in quant attention kernel. Reproducer local-ish: long prompts + large batch.

frank_infra: can we reroute traffic off mr-prod-3 to mr-prod-1/2 temporarily? I'll add a routing rule and spin up a small CPU fallback group. Suggest failover to 'redwood-small-cpu' while we triage.

gina_eng: quick note — we rolled out quant-kernel v2.1 to mr-prod pools ~2h ago. Suspect new kernel path; preparing rollback. Recommend immediate rollback on mr-prod-3 and canary on mr-prod-1.

dave_product: severity? if WidgetCo is impacted we may need to escalate to P1 and notify account team.

eve_support: WidgetCo flagged SLA risk, timestamped logs show 502s since 08:11Z. They want ETA.

alice_oncall: ok tasking: @carla_runtime — collect core + minimal repro, dump stack and upload to incident. @frank_infra — reroute traffic and bring up CPU fallback. @gina_eng — stop rollout/rollback quant-kernel v2.1 on mr-prod-3. @bob_sre — gather traces and set short-term token limits. I'll coordinate customer comms.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-2134. Status: investigating. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-2134

frank_infra: applied routing change at 08:15Z — traffic split set: 80% -> mr-prod-1/2, 20% -> redwood-small-cpu; draining nodes in mr-prod-3. Command run: `routectl set-split --pool mr-prod-3 --fallback redwood-small-cpu --split 20`

bob_sre: short-term mitigation: limit max_input_tokens to 1024 for affected models to reduce KV cache pressure. API proxy rule applied. Curl to change route (example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/update \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
 -d '{"pool":"mr-prod-3","max_input_tokens":1024}'
```

carla_runtime: uploaded core + log bundle to incident storage at s3://incidents/INC-2026-2134/cores/mr-prod-3-8421.tar.gz. Preliminary analysis: OOM then double free in quant kernel when fallback path hit a null pointer.

gina_eng: rollback started at 08:19Z for quant-kernel v2.1 on mr-prod-3: `rbctl rollback rollout/quant-kernel-v2.1 --pool mr-prod-3 --no-canary` — will monitor. If rollback doesn't reduce crashes within 5m, we'll hotpatch to disable the new attention fastpath entirely.

bob_sre: metrics after reroute/rollback: 5xx rate dropped from 14% -> 3.2% within 2m. Latency for CPU fallback increased median by ~120ms but successful responses increased.

alice_oncall: good. customer impact reduced. @eve_support please notify WidgetCo with interim mitigation and ETA for root cause. Keep them updated every 15m.

eve_support: message sent to WidgetCo and BetaOrg. Provided incident link and mitigation steps. They acknowledged and asked for ETA for full resolution.

dave_product: looping in CS and account teams. prepare potential SLA credit calc.

frank_infra: rolling drained nodes out of service; will run heavy-canary on mr-prod-1 after rollback for 30m. Also increased autoscaler threshold to allow spin-up of extra runners if backlog rises.

carla_runtime: confirmed that the rollback removed the new kernel and subsequent runs haven't hit the segfault. Still seeing occasional high memory usage spikes for long prompts; investigating memory accounting logic in kvcache.

gina_eng: filing bug: RG-2456 "quant-kernel v2.1 double-free on OOM" with priority P0. Will schedule hotfix patch; ETA for hotfix build + canary ~90m.

alice_oncall: current status: 5xx reduced to 2.1% cluster-wide, customer-facing errors mostly mitigated via reroute. Incident remains open — action items: root cause RCA, hotfix release, postmortem, customer follow-up. Scheduling 30m follow-up call at 09:00Z.

ops-bot: Updated INC-2026-2134 status -> mitigated.

eve_support: WidgetCo notified of mitigation and that we are working on permanent fix; they requested timeline — provided 90m estimate for hotfix.

alice_oncall: closing pager for now and moving to monitoring. If error rate spikes above 5% reopen. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
